entities.name: Cascade regional blood centre mobile collection drive

process_behavior.meaning: The mobile collection drive collects blood units at a measured average rate of 12 usable units per hour while it is open.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: Open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM America/Los_Angeles.

authority.meaning: The hospital holds the units; it does not control collection or shipping.

attention.calendar_meaning: Shipments arrive after 4 PM on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
attention.meaning: Continuous attention during business hours; receipt occurs upon arrival.

channels.meaning: Physical delivery of blood units from the centre to the hospital.
channels.name: shipment_receipt

commitments.meaning: The hospital receives a shipment from the centre every Tuesday at approximately 7:00 PM America/Los_Angeles (departs 4:00 PM, 3-hour transit).
commitments.name: receive_tuesday_shipment

commitments.meaning: The hospital receives a shipment from the centre every Thursday at approximately 7:00 PM America/Los_Angeles (departs 4:00 PM, 3-hour transit).
